register.matter: 1. Alder Quay Settlement — first working paper and minute

register.finding: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell may jointly consider Ione Berrick and Emmett Vann for income or capital. Neither object is entitled to payment before an appointment in that object's favour. Already authorised for payment: none identifiable in the closed file; no decision reference, payee or amount to list.

register.matter: 2. Flint Orchard Settlement — second working paper and minute
register.origin_reporter: PD-6894-R, clauses 2, 5 and 8, via Bram Lerrit (x2c9); appointments book via Maren Dovell (j8f2).
register.effective_and_received: Deed dated 21 October 2022; extract certified 9 June 2026, held by cut-off. Office reported in the 12 June note.

register.matter: Addition powers, distinct from distribution discretion
register.origin_reporter: Alder clauses 6 and 9 via Tess Arnay; Flint clauses 8 and 12 via Bram Lerrit.
register.effective_and_received: Terms of the 21 October 2022 deeds in the two extracts held by cut-off.
register.finding: Both deeds apply England and Wales law. All serving trustees acting together may by deed add a named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee. Alder specifies no settlor consent; Flint requires no other person's consent. An addition takes effect on joint delivery as a deed. The trustees may identify the settlement at custody delivery by associating the lodged parent reference with the instrument reference. Existing objects remain unless separately removed by deed.
register.competition_and_reason: The settlement name need not be on the designation. The custodian records delivery rather than choosing the parent, designating the person or consenting to the addition.

source_audit.coverage: Maren Dovell reports the appointments book: independent ordinary passage for both named trustees at each settlement. Her own 12 June directions establish order, cut-off and separate records, not an appointment or payment. The underlying book is not a second supplied attachment.

Tess Arnay's 9 June selected extract of the lodged Alder deed supplies Ellis's settlor edge, Ione's and Emmett's object edges, and both original trustee titles. It also supplies one candidate reference, not a link to this delivery. The certificate authenticates the extract; it is not a second deed or fresh appointment. The schedule is omitted.

Bram Lerrit's 9 June extract of the separate Flint deed supplies Cora's settlor edge, Ione's and Orla's object edges, both original trustee titles and the other candidate reference. Similar drafting does not make it a copy of the Alder deed. Certification is not a second decision. Schedules are not reproduced.

Alys Morcant's checked transcript reproduces the signed designation and Della Pennick's attestations; transcript and instrument share an origin. No independent proof of delivery or named trust. Signing, witnessing and certifying do not establish further named trustee edges.

Gideon Sarn's certified extract copies his own live entry; these are not two deliveries or independent witnesses. His account of handover is independent of the signing-room check and complements it. It does not supply the missing digit or name the object. Custody is not trusteeship.

Ione's first-person letter supports the estimate problem, limited permission, request and exclusions. It names no settlement and supplies no independent scored edge. Assistance and lost shifts do not establish kinship.

Una Cresset reports office-account reconciliation, voucher status and the narrow remit entry; no trust-specific distribution or scored edge. Across the file there is no explicit parent_of, sibling_of or spouse_of relationship. Being a contact, adviser, clerk, witness, custodian or meeting secretary is not an ontology edge.
